props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole new tree after a move, or after a branch is collapsed or expanded.

props.name: indentation
props.description: Pixels per level, both for drawing and for how far a drag must travel sideways to change depth.

props.name: maxDepth
props.description: Deepest level an item may be dropped at, counting the top level as 0.

props.name: renderLabel
props.description: Custom row content. Defaults to the label.
